data_output.description: data.py load/encode must preserve the existing split definitions and row order, add request_context categorical fields tab, hour, and weekday using training-only vocabularies with explicit unknown buckets, and return encoded feature matrices, labels for training-only optimization, and user IDs for the existing training proxy. Validation encoding must retain canonical input row order. No ground-truth labels may be written to predictions_valid.npz.

model_input.description: model.py receives the encoded feature matrix as an integer index matrix with one column per categorical field, including user_id, video_id, tab, hour, and weekday. The unchanged additive model sums the corresponding weights and trains with the existing pointwise BCE/Adam procedure. train.py must write predictions_valid.npz with exactly two arrays: row_ids, an int64 sequence matching canonical validation row order, and scores, a finite one-dimensional prediction array of identical length.
